# awesome-local-ai

> A curated list of AI tools that run entirely on local hardware without cloud dependencies or telemetry.

The project is a static list maintained by Brethof AI, covering categories like inference runtimes, voice, and code assistants. It applies strict inclusion rules requiring verifiable local inference and no mandatory accounts. Entries are labeled with platform, license, and language tags, and links are checked for validity.

## Docs

- [awesome-local-ai](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/main/README.md): Curated list of fully local AI tools with strict inclusion rules and verified links.
- [Why this list exists](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#why-this-list-exists): Strict rule requiring inference on owned hardware without transmitting data off-device during normal use.
- [Inclusion rules](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#inclusion-rules): Requirements for local hardware execution, verifiable provenance, and installable artifacts, plus maintenance and removal policies.
- [Legend](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#legend): Icons indicating operating systems, source availability, pricing, programming languages, and recent listing status.
- [Inference Runtimes](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#inference-runtimes): Engines for running LLMs and neural networks locally, including llama.cpp, ExLlamaV3, and LM Studio.
- [Desktop Chat Apps](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#desktop-chat-apps): GUI applications wrapping local runtimes in chat interfaces, such as Anything LLM and Open WebUI.
- [Voice — Speech-to-Text](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#voice--speech-to-text): Offline speech-to-text tools like Buzz, Dictámelo, and faster-whisper for transcription and translation.
- [Voice — Text-to-Speech](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#voice--text-to-speech): Local text-to-speech engines including Piper, Kokoro, VoxCPM2, and Chatterbox for voice synthesis.
- [Image Generation](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#image-generation): Local image generation tools such as ComfyUI, InvokeAI, Forge, and Radiant Canvas.
- [Video Generation](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#video-generation): Local video generation tools including ComfyUI with LTX Video and WanGP for consumer GPUs.
- [Code Assistants](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#code-assistants): Aider, Cline, Llama.vim, Tabby, and twinny for local code completion, editing, and agent-based assistance.
- [Local Agents](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#local-agents): Aider, goose, Hyperconsciousness, Open Interpreter, and Tree Ring Memory for local coding agents and memory systems.
- [Vector Databases](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#vector-databases): Chroma, Faiss, LanceDB, Qdrant, sqlite-vec, and Weaviate for local vector storage, similarity search, and hybrid retrieval.
- [Embeddings](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#embeddings): BGE, fastembed, and Sentence Transformers for generating local text embeddings using CPU or GPU acceleration.
- [Training & Fine-tuning](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#training--fine-tuning): AI Toolkit, Axolotl, diffusion-pipe, MLX, and Unsloth for training and fine-tuning local AI models.
- [Local Search & RAG](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#local-search--rag): Anything LLM, LlamaIndex, PrivateGPT, SearXNG, and Vane for local search, RAG pipelines, and private AI apps.
- [Operating Systems Tuned for AI](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#operating-systems-tuned-for-ai): CachyOS and Pop!_OS, two Linux distributions tuned for local AI and GPU driver support.
- [Hardware-Specific Runtimes](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#hardware-specific-runtimes): Hardware-specific runtimes including Lemonade, MLX LM, TensorRT-LLM, OpenVINO, and ROCm for various AI hardware.
- [Related work](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#related-work): Links to related projects covering llms.txt tools, privacy AI, MCP servers, licenses, Linux distros, and ComfyUI workflows.
